alan.open: I am Alan, Marquis's coaching in software form. Seven taps, no typing. We find the loop you are in, pick one move, and set a time.
alan.want: Start with what you want. Pick the closest one.
alan.loop: Now, where does it get stuck? Pick the one that sounds most like you.
alan.play: Here is the loop, and here is the move that gets you past it.
alan.commit: A move only counts if it has a time. When will you do it?
alan.sheet: That is your call sheet. It is short on purpose.
alan.counter: If you want company on this, here is what is on the counter.

referOutNote: If this feels heavy or constant, or you are not coping, please talk to a doctor or therapist. Coaching is not treatment.
proof: Marquis Harmon is a mindset coach and supreme accountability partner. He has spoken at the United Nations, COP22, the World Syrian Refugee Summit, and Hive at Harvard Business School.

story-rewrite.hook: You did not stop wanting it. You rewrote the story so quitting would not hurt.
story-rewrite.story: [Marquis: a time you quietly changed what you said you wanted]

borrowed-goal.hook: Whose voice is behind your goal? If nobody ever knew you got it, would you still want it?
borrowed-goal.story: [Marquis: a goal you chased for someone else's approval]

wish-without-obstacle.hook: You can see the finish line perfectly. Can you name the one thing that will stop you this week?
wish-without-obstacle.story: [Marquis: a plan that fell apart in the middle, not at the start]

intention-action-gap.hook: You know exactly what to do. So why are you still not doing it?
intention-action-gap.story: [Marquis: something you knew to do and did not, and what finally moved you]

rumination.hook: Same conversation, 2am, again. Here is the question that breaks the replay.
rumination.story: [Marquis: a loop you were stuck in, only if you want to share it]

defensiveness.hook: Someone gave you honest feedback and you got angry. That is information, not an insult.
defensiveness.story: [Marquis: feedback that stung and turned out right]

all-or-nothing.hook: You missed one day and decided the whole plan was dead. Plan the miss instead.
all-or-nothing.story: [Marquis: a streak you broke and what you did next]

fixed-label.hook: "I am just not a ___ person." Add one word: yet. Then add one practice.
fixed-label.story: [Marquis: a label you used to wear, for example the one you were given at 8]

willpower-myth.hook: Stop arguing with your willpower. Change the cue, not the person.
willpower-myth.story: [Marquis: a time you changed the room instead of trying harder]

cta: Alan finds your loop in seven taps, no typing. Link in bio.
